description: PanAdipo score -> CCTA EAT. y = a*log10(score) + b (OLS, manuscript Fig. 3A); PIs from empirical residual quantiles; P(high EAT) from 20 score bins.
cohort: YNHHS-ORFAN echo-CCTA pairs within 365 days, one pair per patient, held out from PanAdipo development (BOA segmentation)
checkpoint: PanAdipo v1.0 weights (release asset best_model.pt, md5 1aa0ce1989506553dca91f3982a199cf)

targets.eat_index: EAT volume / total heart volume (LV myocardium + LV + RV + LA + RA)
targets.eat_volume_ml: BOA epicardial adipose tissue volume, mL (-190 to -30 HU within pericardium)

high_eat_definition: eat_index >= 95th percentile within age (<50, 50-64, >=65 y) x sex

age_sex.definition: high EAT = eat_index >= 95th percentile within age group x sex
